parts.label: (b)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
For each fair spinner, probability of any score is 0.25. Valid $(R,B,G)$ scenarios are $(1,1,2)$, $(1,2,1)$ and $(1,1,1)$, each with probability $0.28(0.25)^2=0.0175$, and $(2,1,1)$ with probability $0.12(0.25)^2=0.0075$. B1 for the correct probability of one identified scenario, unsimplified accepted, www. M1 for adding the four correct scenario values, possibly implied by correct unsimplified expressions, with no incorrect or repeated scenarios. $0.06$ (A1); if A0, SC B1 for 0.06 www.

parts.label: (c)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
$P(X\text{ odd})=0.28+2(0.12)=0.52$ (B1), alone or as conditional-probability denominator; unsimplified accepted. Valid $(R,B,G)$ scenarios: for $R=1$, $(1,1),(1,2),(1,3),(1,4),(2,1),(2,2),(3,1),(4,1)$, each probability $0.28(0.25)^2=0.0175$; for $R=3$, $(1,1)$ with probability $0.24(0.25)^2=0.015$. M1 for adding at least five identified correct scenarios, unsimplified accepted; condone incorrect scenarios in this calculation. Numerator $=8(0.28)(0.25)^2+(0.24)(0.25)^2=0.155$ (M1 for $x(0.28)(0.25)^2+(0.24)(0.25)^2$, $x=4,5,6,7,8$, alone or as numerator/denominator). Conditional probability $=0.155/0.52$ (M1 for the corresponding identified intersection divided by identified $P(X\text{ odd})$). $0.298=155/520=31/104$ (A1), accept $0.2980769\ldots$ to at least 3 s.f.
Total [5]
